# Video script: An early look at the heart

> DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Contains claims with status 'ai-extracted' that no clinician has verified.

Unit D9 | Target length: 5 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Presenter to camera | In a low-risk pregnancy, a look at the heart at the early scan can be done where possible. It is not compulsory. The least you confirm is a heart inside the chest, beating regularly. | IS23-090, IS23-091 |
| 2 | Machine console: transducer selection and thermal index display | High-frequency transabdominal probe; a transvaginal probe can be used. Thermal index one or less. Doppler mainly on two views, and briefly. | IS23-092, IS23-093 |
| 3 | Early four-chamber clip, grey-scale then colour | Situs and axis on grey-scale. Four chambers on grey-scale, then with colour or bidirectional power Doppler. | IS23-094 |
| 4 | Early three-vessel-and-trachea clip in colour | The three-vessel-and-trachea view with colour or bidirectional power Doppler. Two arches, both on the left. Keep Doppler time short. | IS23-094, IS23-093 |
| 5 | Presenter | Outflow tracts are hard this early and easy to get wrong. If you suspect heart disease, refer for an early fetal echocardiogram. | IS23-095 |
